task1.title: Structure of a simple solar panel and how it works
task1.prompt: The diagrams below show the structure of a simple solar panel and how it works.

stages.label: Box with a Transparent Top
stages.detail: Shows the basic structure consisting of a box frame, a transparent top cover, an inlet tube on the left, and an outlet tube on the right.

stages.label: Solar Panel to Heat Air
stages.detail: Sun Rays (Heat Energy) pass through the Transparent Top, heating cool air entering through the inlet, which exits as warm air through the outlet.

stages.label: Solar Panel to Heat Water
stages.detail: Sun Rays (Heat Energy) penetrate the Transparent Top to heat cool water flowing through an internal paper pipe, releasing warm water through the outlet.

chartDesc.overview: The graphic illustrates the structural components of a simple solar panel box and its two operating modes for heating air and water. In both modes, cool air or water enters via an inlet, is heated inside the box by solar rays passing through a transparent top, and exits as warm air or water through an outlet.
keyFeatures: Linear flow process from inlet on the left to outlet on the right.
Both systems use sun rays (heat energy) directed through a transparent top into a box base.
The water-heating variation includes an internal paper pipe, unlike the air-heating system which allows air to pass directly through the box space.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The three diagrams illustrate how a simple solar panel is constructed and the two ways in which it can be used, namely to heat air and to heat water.

Overall, the panel is essentially a shallow box with a transparent top, and its design is almost identical in both applications. The main difference lies in what circulates inside the box: air in the first case, and water, which is carried through a winding pipe, in the second.

Looking at the structure first, the panel consists of a rectangular box with an inlet on one side and an outlet on the other. The box is covered by a transparent top, which allows the sun's rays to reach the inside of the panel.

When the panel is used for heating air, cool air is drawn in through the inlet, and heat energy from the sun passes through the transparent top and warms this air inside the box, after which warm air leaves through the outlet. The process for heating water is very similar, except that the cool water entering the panel travels along a paper pipe inside the box, where it gradually absorbs heat before flowing out of the outlet as warm water.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Uchta diagrammada oddiy quyosh paneli qanday tuzilgani hamda undan foydalanishning ikki usuli — ya'ni havoni isitish va suvni isitish — ko'rsatilgan.

Umuman olganda, panel mohiyatan shaffof qopqoqli sayoz quti bo'lib, ikkala holatda ham uning tuzilishi deyarli bir xil. Asosiy farq quti ichida nima aylanishida: birinchi holatda havo, ikkinchisida esa egri-bugri quvur orqali o'tadigan suv.

Avvalo tuzilishga qaraydigan bo'lsak, panel bir tomonida kirish teshigi, boshqa tomonida chiqish teshigi bo'lgan to'rtburchak qutidan tashkil topgan. Qutining usti quyosh nurlarini panel ichiga o'tkazadigan shaffof qopqoq bilan yopilgan.

Panel havoni isitish uchun ishlatilganda, salqin havo kirish teshigi orqali ichkariga tortiladi, quyoshdan kelayotgan issiqlik energiyasi shaffof qopqoq orqali o'tib, quti ichidagi shu havoni isitadi, so'ngra iliq havo chiqish teshigidan tashqariga chiqadi. Suvni isitish jarayoni ham juda o'xshash, faqat panelga kirayotgan salqin suv quti ichidagi qog'oz quvur bo'ylab harakatlanadi va chiqish teshigidan iliq suv bo'lib chiqishidan oldin issiqlikni asta-sekin o'ziga singdiradi.

task2.title: Girls choose arts subjects, boys choose science subjects
task2.prompt: In many schools and universities, girls tend to choose arts subjects (e.g., languages), while boys choose science subjects (e.g., physics). What do you think are the reasons for this? Do you think this tendency should be changed?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
In many parts of the world, girls tend to opt for arts subjects such as languages, while boys gravitate towards sciences like physics. In my view, this pattern is largely the result of social conditioning rather than natural ability, and I believe it should be actively challenged.

There appear to be two main reasons for this tendency. Firstly, children absorb gender stereotypes from a very early age. Toys, films and even casual comments from adults often suggest that technical fields are "for boys", whereas creative or linguistic pursuits are "for girls", and by the time students choose their subjects, many are simply following the path that society expects of them. Secondly, the shortage of visible role models reinforces the pattern: a girl who rarely sees female physicists or engineers may struggle to imagine herself in such a career, while a boy interested in languages may abandon them because of peer pressure and the fear of seeming different.

I strongly believe this tendency should be changed, because subject choice ought to reflect aptitude and genuine interest rather than gender. On a practical level, many countries face shortages of engineers, nurses and teachers, and encouraging both sexes to consider every field would widen the talent pool considerably. Schools can play a decisive role here by inviting women working in science to speak to students, and by offering gender-neutral career guidance that presents every subject as a realistic option for everyone.

In conclusion, the divide between girls' and boys' subject choices stems mainly from stereotypes and a lack of role models, and I believe deliberate efforts to close this gap are both desirable and long overdue.
task2.uzSampleBand8:
Dunyoning ko'plab joylarida qizlar tillar kabi gumanitar fanlarni tanlashga moyil bo'lsa, o'g'il bolalar fizika kabi aniq fanlarga intiladi. Menimcha, bu holat tabiiy qobiliyatdan ko'ra ko'proq ijtimoiy muhit ta'siri natijasidir va unga faol qarshi turish kerak deb hisoblayman.

Bu tendensiyaning ikkita asosiy sababi bor ko'rinadi. Birinchidan, bolalar gender stereotiplarini juda erta yoshdan o'zlashtiradi. O'yinchoqlar, filmlar va hatto kattalarning oddiy gaplari ham texnik sohalar "o'g'il bolalar uchun", ijodiy yoki til yo'nalishlari esa "qizlar uchun" degan fikrni singdiradi, natijada fan tanlash vaqti kelganda ko'pchilik shunchaki jamiyat kutgan yo'ldan boradi. Ikkinchidan, ko'zga ko'ringan ibrat namunalarining kamligi bu holatni yanada mustahkamlaydi: ayol fizik yoki muhandislarni deyarli ko'rmagan qiz o'zini bunday kasbda tasavvur qilishi qiyin, tillarga qiziqqan o'g'il bola esa tengdoshlar bosimi va boshqacha ko'rinishdan qo'rqib, bu qiziqishidan voz kechishi mumkin.

Men bu tendensiyani o'zgartirish kerakligiga qat'iy ishonaman, chunki fan tanlash jinsga emas, balki qobiliyat va chinakam qiziqishga asoslanishi lozim. Amaliy jihatdan olganda, ko'plab mamlakatlar muhandislar, hamshiralar va o'qituvchilar yetishmasligiga duch kelmoqda, va har ikkala jinsni barcha sohalarni ko'rib chiqishga undash iqtidorlar doirasini sezilarli kengaytiradi. Bu borada maktablar hal qiluvchi rol o'ynashi mumkin: fanda ishlayotgan ayollarni o'quvchilar bilan uchrashuvga taklif qilish va har bir fanni hamma uchun real tanlov sifatida ko'rsatadigan xolis kasbga yo'naltirish xizmatini yo'lga qo'yish orqali.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, qizlar va o'g'il bolalarning fan tanlovidagi farq asosan stereotiplar va ibrat namunalari yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi, va men bu farqni yo'qotishga qaratilgan maqsadli sa'y-harakatlar ham zarur, ham allaqachon kechikkan deb hisoblayman.
